page.layout: One block of text, centred on the page: a title, a subtitle in italic, and three lines of list entries. No margins with text, no running head, no page number.
page.notes: The scan is a yellowed, slightly rotated page with a dark book edge at the right; the stains and specks are not printed text. The list lines use the printer's own spacing and abbreviations (D.D.a, fol.208, num 1), which are copied as printed. "Tropæum" is printed with the ligature æ; "Tropęum" in the scan reads as Tropæum. The numeral "2" in "num 2" and "fol.212" is set in an old-style form and read as 2 and 212.
